round_1.decisive_fact: public_read_k1c requires indices/public.json, and NO code path in the repository ever writes that object. Verified by the orchestrator: four read sites (grants.rs:627, :632, remote.rs:333 allowlist, lib.rs:222 grammar, bundle.rs:1300) and zero writes. Every draft.2 edition this repository can produce carries public/sections/<sid>.md and no public index, so the function would fail on all of them. An uncalled function whose input does not exist proves nothing about the Rule.
